# FLX-2102: the recorded plan's own planDigest has moved

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

The plan.json read back from the run directory does not hash to the planDigest it was written with -- it was edited, truncated, or written by an incompatible version after the fact. A plan is a fixed point once written; re-run `fluxsim plan` to produce a fresh one rather than editing this one by hand.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2102
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
